detail: Transit zone recorded but the value is null.
_expected_failure: status 'recorded' with transit_zone null: a recorded status must carry the verbatim PLUTO transit-zone text, so the allOf/oneOf 'status, status_label, transit_zone, missing_source and missing_source_ref move together' rejects it at the root. missing_source and missing_source_ref are both null (correct for recorded), so the only defect is the null transit_zone.
